evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies BlockTemplateManager and interfaces::Mining to track template memory footprint.
rationale: Exposes template memory consumption via `getMemoryLoad()` to external mining consumers like Stratum v2. When external IPC clients hold template references, evicted mempool transactions remain pinned in memory without visibility; this adds accounting and query capability actively integrated in downstream SV2 tooling (`stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63`).
